summary: Commercial homestay management app where users can add/manage homestays. Currently facing an authorization error preventing non-admin users from saving homestays.
architectural_notes: Homestay save operation requires authenticated admin role — authorization check is blocking regular users from adding homestays
known_issues: 'Failed to save homestay: Unauthorized: Only authenticated admins can add homestays' error is shown when trying to save a homestay — authorization logic is too restrictive

existing_features.title: Update the HomeStayManagement frontend component to remove any client-side admin-only guard or error handling that blocks non-admin authenticated users from submitting the add-homestay form, ensuring the form submission reaches the backend for all authenticated users.

new_feature_requests.summary: Remove or relax the admin-only authorization guard on the 'addHomeStay' (or equivalent) backend function so that authenticated users (including partners and non-admin authenticated principals) can successfully create and save homestay listings without receiving an 'Unauthorized: Only authenticated admins can add homestays' error.

projectName: Fix unauthorized error when saving homestays
